evidence.reason: The fixture creates its baseline commit at line 94 after setting only user.email/user.name; it never disables inherited commit.gpgSign or passes --no-gpg-sign. On a machine with global commit.gpgSign=true and no usable signing key or available signing agent, the commit in setUp fails and every DeployTests case errors. Setting repo-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit, or using --no-gpg-sign, is the minimal hermetic fix; this is ordinary test correctness, not a new contract requirement.
